acceptance_oracle: A successful profile-owned company discovery persists the company source and appends one COMPANY_DISCOVERED and, when that source is newly enrolled, one COMPANY_SOURCE_ENROLLED event in the same transaction. Activity renders fixed safe summaries after reload, exposes neither raw source URLs nor payloads, and does not show another profile's events.
gap_observation: Company discovery persisted company/source records but did not add profile-owned user-facing company events. The Activity timeline already supported safe profile and application event summaries.
implementation: Company discovery passes the initiating profile into the source upsert; source creation/refresh and profile audit writes share one database transaction.
COMPANY_DISCOVERED uses a stable profile/company identity and remains idempotent on rediscovery.
COMPANY_SOURCE_ENROLLED is appended only when a source record is first created; its stable profile/source identity prevents duplicate timeline entries.
The audit read model resolves company names from stored IDs and emits fixed summaries without exposing audit payloads, URLs, or source endpoints.
Blocked or unsuccessful discovery paths do not emit either company success event.
